etsy.title: Kindness Advent Calendar Printable, 24 Kindness Cards for Kids, Random Acts of Kindness Christmas Countdown, Kindness Elf Ideas, Classroom
etsy.description:
An advent calendar that grows kind hearts instead of a sugar rush. 🎄

24 small kindness missions, one for every day of December. Each takes 5–20 minutes and needs little or no shopping: feed the birds, thank a helper, call a grandparent, bake for a neighbor, include someone who is alone.

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE (11 pages)
• 24 kindness mission cards with a helpful tip on each (cut and keep)
• 6 blank cards for your own family missions
• Color-in kindness tracker (1–24)
• 8 dinner-table kindness talk cards
• Mini kind notes + 6 Christmas joke cards
• Kindness Champion certificate for Christmas Eve

Use it with any advent calendar, numbered envelopes, a jar, or let your Christmas elf deliver one card each morning.

👧👦 For kids ages 3 to 12, families and classrooms.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. US Letter + A4 PDF included. Print at home on paper or card stock.

PLEASE NOTE
For personal and single-classroom use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
